note: City campground on the south bank of the Big Sioux River at the head of the Dells channel, between two ball fields off S Garfield Ave, within walking distance of historic downtown Dell Rapids. One loop of back-in sites on open grass; a paved riverside trail with a pedestrian bridge runs along the bank. Next to an active baseball field. --Claude
summary: City pages read (2026): 29 sites, W/E $30 (6-15), full hookup $40 (1-5, 16-29), online registration via Reservation Friend, 1-year window, weekend 2-night min, open ~May 15-Oct 1. Fees/season/booking added. Old website URL 404 -> /campground/index.php. WATERFRONT: riverfront -> riverview recommended (loop road + trail between pads and the river).
